verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching on responsive resizing is a changelog mention of 'Stacks' (Sketch's auto-layout-like feature) supporting negative gaps and min-max sizing, which implies some auto-layout capability exists. There is no documentation shown for constraints (pin/resize behavior) or responsive grids, and no first-party or hands-on walkthrough of how frames resize like real UIs. missing for 10: explicit constraints/pinning documentation, resizing-grid documentation, hands-on demonstration of responsive frame behavior across breakpoints.
